enable_mixed_precision: enable mixed precision training by setting the global dtype to tf.float16
disable_mixed_precision: disable mixed precision training and restore full float32 precision
create_modes_decorator: create a decorator with modes to cast function inputs and outputs to eligible precision types
use_scope_context: use the scope context manager to temporarily set mixed precision dtype for a code block
cast_tensor_structure: cast tensor and variable structures to a target floating-point dtype automatically
